ambiguities_or_notes: Both page markers, section number and title, the complete stones parable, every turn of the elder's explanation, and the concluding sentence are represented; the exact source SHA-256 matched the mounted audited Russian snapshot.
«старец» is 'elder' and «раба божья» 'servant of God', retaining the spiritual setting without adding a denominational title not present in the source.
The two instructions preserve the physical contrast: one stone as large as the first woman can lift, versus as many stones as the second can manage, all of them small.

«несла за него укоры людей и своей совести» is kept as 'bore for it the reproaches of people and of your own conscience'; the source's causal sequence through remembrance, reproach, humility, and release from consequences remains intact.

The unusual official reading «всё глубже и глубже завязала в своих» is also present in the printed/electronic volume 41 witness. In context it is rendered 'became more and more entangled in your own', without altering the immutable Russian source.
